project.name: HappyClaw marketing site — responsive CTA review
project.goal: Help enterprise teams understand the private deployment offer and choose the right next step
project.audience: Enterprise teams evaluating a self-hosted AI agent platform
project.task: Choose between trying the product, viewing the source and contacting the team

assets.name: HappyClaw full logo
assets.description: Orange claw mark with the HappyClaw wordmark

evidence.observation: The three hero actions are forced into one equal-width row. The middle label is visibly truncated to ‘View on GitHu...’, so the destination is not fully communicated.
At the mobile breakpoint, .hero-cta disables wrapping and each link uses min-width: 0, overflow: hidden and text-overflow: ellipsis.
The action group mixes Chinese labels with ‘View on GitHub’, increasing label length and weakening consistency for the Chinese page.

findings.title: The mobile hero truncates a primary decision label
findings.proposal: Keep all three actions understandable at 390px. Use concise Chinese labels and a responsive layout that preserves complete text and clear primary, secondary and contact priority without ellipsis.

review.before: Current branch 70a9980 captured at 1280×800 and 390×844; the mobile GitHub action is truncated.
